# Frozen checkouts vendored for one Palomar SHA (same layout as catskillsresearch/scott_models).
# Each vendor/<repo> is compiled as a [[lean_lib]] of THIS package with srcDir = "vendor/<repo>"
# (lakefile.toml), never as a Lake path dependency: Comparator's landrun sandbox may write only
# under .lake/, and a path package would write vendor/<repo>/.lake (EACCES).
# Requirements of a vendored library (here kolmogorov_extension4) are pinned root git requires
# under .lake/packages, like Carleson and Mathlib. No .git / .lake / docs build products copied.
# Upstream remotes remain the homes of these libraries; full pins also in vendor/SOURCES.

vendor/brownian-motion   (lean_lib BrownianMotion)
  origin:   https://github.com/RemyDegenne/brownian-motion
  rev:      497e5e2a60450796f75ab920e6c33addae4d644d
  from:     ../xodarev2026/vendor/brownian-motion @ xodarev2026 0e1f1f3b0739fdf472511da2207599ab11085660
            (itself ../lyasoff2016/vendor/brownian-motion, copied 2026-11-21; lyasoff pin dated 2026-11-18)
  date:     2026-11-26 (copied into this repository)
  in-tree edits:
    - Unfinished (sorry) declarations removed from the build closure, inherited from the
      lyasoff2016 copy: DoobLp L^p iSup; UniformIntegrable limitProcess / Submartingale
      stoppedValue; OptionalSampling stoppedValue_min; LocalMartingale isStable_submartingale.
      Consequently the BrownianMotion umbrella (ClassD) does not build; only the concrete
      modules we import are built.
    - 2026-11-27: ENNReal.one_le_toReal renamed ENNReal.one_le_toReal_of_ne_top in
      BrownianMotion/Auxiliary/ENNReal.lean (declaration line 29, use line 35) and
      BrownianMotion/Auxiliary/Jensen.lean (use line 47), to avoid a clash with
      Carleson/ToMathlib/RealInterpolation/InterpolatedExponents.lean:45 (carleson @ f7487cc).
    - Its own Palomar/docs packaging (verso, lakefile requires checkdecls/subverso) is not used;
      vendor/brownian-motion/lakefile.toml is kept for reference but not read by Lake.
  requires: kolmogorov_extension4 @ c20f168ed693537c78111ffeabc2ab5f384e35d6 (root git require)
  used by:  WeakPathwiseIto/Bessel/WienerLawExists.lean (proof of CanonicalWienerSpace.exists_isLaw)
